scale.note: Grim Dawn BH = 1.8 m is INFERRED (Legolas §2); every BH figure in this file inherits that grade. 130 px/BH ÷ 1.8 m/BH = 72.2 px/m — the conversion used by every metre-derived figure below.

collision.note: the flask is ground-locked and does not strike bodies in flight; the R-C5-96 canonical capsule is the FORWARD-CAST (G1) collider and does not apply here. Contrast poisonous_concoction, whose flask CAN hit a body mid-flight and therefore does carry a capsule.

presentation.lick_coherence: low — turbulent flicker with a characteristic timescale, NOT a pulse train and NOT the 1 Hz damage tick

primitive_bindings.projectile: RGB flask (material, opaque dark glass, pale reflection) — NOT value-index. Source mesh is literally boozebottle_molotov01.msh held at R Hand.
primitive_bindings.impact: flask shatter: white-hot bloom + radiating light streaks + an expanding pale elliptical GROUND RING (shockwave) resolving into flame. Body = fire_burst_e0p_v3 at 0.7 scale — the CURRENT fire vocabulary (interleave kit, count 5–7, gaps ≤40°) WITH the FL-5 ending: a small central white-core painted decal that subsides, tighter/smaller embers, and a little smoky fog shrouding them. 3 glass shards (RGB) RETAINED as HOUSE — footage could not resolve them.
primitive_bindings.field: low, dense, BOILING DISC of orange-yellow flame with a white-hot centre, ragged orange fringe and SHORT TURBULENT TONGUES (not tall discrete licks), red-orange outer glow; ground-bound decal + particles (terrainOnly), 0.58 squash. Tongue flicker runs at its own 3.3–3.6 Hz turbulent rate, decoupled from the damage ticks.
primitive_bindings.residue: scorch decal 12.0 s — an IRREGULAR DARK SMUDGE WITH SOFT EDGES, not a clean circle, with faint smoke wisps and a few residual flame licks; fade begins at 11.0 s, fade-in 0.1 s

exporter_needs: G2 lick clock — a lick_flicker_hz / lick_coherence particle channel INDEPENDENT of tick_schedule_s (the source runs two clocks: 1 Hz damage, 3.3–3.6 Hz turbulent flicker; the current pulse asset is driven off the tick schedule)
G2 cadence_kind on the field tick train (metronome | jittered) so F1 flips in one pass; tick_schedule_report must REPORT cadence CV, never assert it
G2 residue ≫ field — a 12.0 s decal against a 2.5 s pool, drawn as an IRREGULAR SOFT-EDGED SMUDGE, not a circle, with fadeAfter 11.0 s / fade-in 0.1 s
G2 landing clamp to the walkable union with flight time scaled to the actual clamped distance (already live per R-C5-112; carried here so the spec states it)
impact body re-pointed from fire_burst_e0p_v2 to fire_burst_e0p_v3 at 0.7 scale, inheriting the FL-5 ending (core_residue + smoke + tightened ember_ending) and the interleave library
exact-set mechanics._keys must admit source_rank, burn_dot_s, arc.launch_angle_deg, range_max_source_px, landing_clamp, collision, bounce, g2_mode

provenance.range_px 520: HOUSE — the touch forward-cast default, R-C5-92 (no aim assist; drag-to-aim is the accepted direction) and the LANE convention already baked at R-C5-106/112. The source max (15 m = 8.33 BH = 1083 px, VERIFIED .arz, Legolas Table B §2) is preserved in range_max_source_px and is NOT lost.
provenance.arc.flight_s 0.40 / arc.apex_px 42: DERIVED at the 520 px house range: flight = 520 ÷ (18 m/s × 72.2 px/m) = 0.400 s; apex = 520 · tan(18°) ÷ 4 = 42 px. launchAngle 18.0° is VERIFIED (.arz, Table B §2). At the source's own 1083 px these become 0.83 s / 88 px — that pair is the v1 draft's and is correct for the SOURCE range, not for the lane.
provenance.landing_clamp walkable_union: R-C5-112 — BL-1a-r1: the G2 landing is clamped to the walkable union; all eight directions land walkable and flight is scaled with the clamped distance. F-C5-35 (pool in the sky / on the void) was the defect this closed. NEW in v2 — the v1 draft omitted a lane fact already in the build.
provenance.field.radius_px 181 / field_diameter 2.7: Legolas Table B §2 per-rank table — RANK 1: projectileExplosionRadius 2.5 m = 2.78 BH diameter (VERIFIED). Rank 12 = 6.44 BH, rank 22 = 7.11 BH; this spec declares RANK 1 (R-C5-106).
provenance.field.duration_s 2.5: Legolas Table B §2 per-rank table — RANK 1 pool duration (VERIFIED .arz; the wiki's 4.0 s is a version behind)
provenance.tick_schedule_s [0,1,2] / tick_interval_: Legolas §4 + §0(b) + Table B §2 — targetInterval = 1000 ms, a flat 1 Hz metronome, CV = 0 (VERIFIED). Three ticks fit the 2.5 s rank-1 pool. Authored per CHARTER F1 RECOMMENDATION (a): mechanics cadences follow the source metronomes. The lane's live irregular schedule [0, .3, .95, 1.25, 2] is HOUSE FF-08 (R-C5-55/106) and is SUPERSEDED here pending F1.
provenance.tick_cv_min 0.25: HOUSE — retained as a key so the exporter contract does not change shape, but under F1(a) the authored schedule does NOT satisfy it. The exporter must REPORT cadence CV, never assert it.
provenance.ff08: CHARTER F1 / Q80 F4, PENDING — authored at recommendation (a): FF-08 is a HOUSE rule scoped to the PAINTED layer only; mechanics cadences follow the source metronome. For this file the painted-layer irregularity F1(a) governs lives in the KIT (fire_burst_e0p_v3 pieces.erode_noise / boil, ember timing), not in any key here. NOTE THE EXEMPTION: lick_flicker_hz is MEASURED SOURCE (§12.1 row 4b), not house jitter, and survives ANY F1 ruling — it is not marked pending. If Matt rules (c) keep-universal, flip only the four keys in pending_rulings back to the BL-1a irregular schedule.
provenance.burn_dot_s 3.0: Legolas §4 — burn duration is a FLAT 3.0 s regardless of rank and is a DIFFERENT CLOCK from the pool duration (VERIFIED). The prior spec conflated the two.
provenance.bounce false: HOUSE — the source flask IS a physics body that can bounce (physicsRestitution 1.0, physicsFriction 16.0, dedicated bounce sound, VERIFIED §4). We author a clean arc-and-shatter for E3-r1; declared deviation, re-openable.
provenance.collision.in_flight none: R-C5-96 — the canonical capsule (radius 0.25 BH, swept from the release socket, target must lie ≥0.25 BH ahead along the facing) is the G1 FORWARD-CAST collider. Blackwater is ground-locked to a landing point and strikes nothing in flight, so no capsule is authored. Stated explicitly rather than left absent.
provenance.residue 12.0 s: Legolas Table B §2 — decal life 12.0 s, fadeAfter 11.0 s, fadeIn 0.1 s (VERIFIED). The prior 1.0 s was off by >10×.
provenance.residue form + residue_diameter 3.2: Legolas §12.1 row 4c — MEASURED, form MED / BH LOW (≈4.3 BH at that clip's unknown rank; scaled here to rank 1's 2.78 BH field × the same ~1.15 residue:field ratio → 3.2 BH, DERIVED)
provenance.field form (boiling disc, white-hot cent: Legolas §12.1 row 4c — MEASURED, MED; ground decal + particles per §4 (terrainOnly = True; sphere.msh is an invisible collider)
provenance.lick_flicker_hz 3.3–3.6, low coherence: Legolas §12.1 row 4b — MEASURED, MED: autocorrelation over 200 frames @60 fps gives a ≈0.28–0.30 s characteristic period at +0.10 to +0.25 coherence. Emphatically NOT the 1 Hz damage tick.
provenance.impact body fire_burst_e0p_v3 + FL-5 end: R-C5-122 (Matt on cliffside_v40: bring back SOME of the painted/decal section with a matching white-hot glow; embers too large and too spread out; add a little smoky fog shrouding the embers; the white-hot glow as a small central painted decal that subsides) + R-C5-124 (FL-5 Part E: interleave count 5–7, scale 1.2–1.6×, gaps ≤40°). The v3 kit carries interleave.count [5,7], core_residue 0.6 BH / 0.5 s, smoke 0.8 BH / 0.9 s and the tightened ember_ending. The v1 draft still named fire_burst_e0p_v2 — that vocabulary is a lap behind.
provenance.3 glass shards: HOUSE — STILL UNKNOWN at source. §12.5 / §12.7 item 1: footage tried at 1080p/60 and FAILED; the remaining route is the .pfx inside the packed .arc. Retained as a house choice, not a source fact.
provenance.material flask RGB: 03- § 2.3 material-glass gate; corroborated by the source mesh + potion-drop sound (Legolas §4)
provenance.v1_delta: v1 (13:12) authored the SOURCE range (1083 px / 0.83 s / 88 px apex). v2 restores the LANE convention (520 px HOUSE + range_max_source_px), adds landing_clamp and collision, re-points the impact to the v3 fire vocabulary, and marks the FF-08 keys pending C-7 F1.
